notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Intro Cutscene 
-	Fixed character with odd head bob teleport in the intro cutscene. 
-	Cut the cutscene to start after the characters finish talking and resume the game.
-	Cut the odd character rotation at the end with no realistic body pivot. 
-	Rerecorded new voice lines for the intro cutscene to blend with the scene mood of the intro cutscene and took into consideration natural pauses. 
-	Removed Ambience Hub music from the cutscene and reenabled it after the cutscene ended. 
Women (Lucy) Threat 
-	Updated (Lucy) women's house sequence to not include the women after the event has ended. 
-	Updated (Lucy) women's painting puzzle placement to be more random. 
Unlock look input Cutscene. 
-	Enabled look input on selected cutscenes. 
Computer App 
-	Added a Redacted folder to display computer information.
Final Cutscene
-	Fix the final cutscene body going through the mesh. 
Other fixes 
-	Fixed rain that kept on running upon entering a house. 
-      Fixed Death achievement to track deaths when the player dies correctly.

- Giovanni
